verdict.rationale: Buzz exposes a programmatic surface (Nostr relay plus REST and admin APIs), so this story applies. However, the evidence shows no machine-readable API spec: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returns 404, and an independent repo scan found zero openapi/swagger files. Its protocol extensions exist only as markdown NIP drafts. The Persona Pack JSON schema and the NIP-11 relay-information document are adjacent artifacts, not a downloadable API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
